relationships.basis: Alexander Glasgow-2695, the Midlothian agricultural labourer/ploughman, reports Colinton (also rendered Callington) as his birthplace, with census-implied births about 1801–1803. Alexander Glasgow-2718 was born 17 March 1799 and baptised 31 March at Colinton, residence Greysmill, explicitly to John Glasgow and Margaret Muckle. The distinctive birth parish, compatible two-to-four-year census age discrepancy and the family’s later Kirknewton context support identifying the childhood and adult accounts. John/Margaret’s recorded children at Kirknewton and East Calder in 1808–1814 provide a positive locality bridge to adult Alexander’s son John, born at Kirknewton about 1829. The first held son’s name John is only a minor, correlated clue. A bounded FamilySearch search for Alexander Glasgow, Colinton, 1795–1806 in Scotland Births and Baptisms returned the 1799child and two occurrences of the adult as a father; no closer childhood candidate was returned. This supports selecting the record-defined John Glasgow-1304 as the adult’s father at 65% subjective confidence, a new working attachment rather than a profile merger.
